name: Multicolor Lamp 16x
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A lamp built on the LEDs 16x ring. Every LED has its own white light, so it gives a clean neutral white as well as any colour, or a colour softened with white. Control it from the app, which also shows the ring's temperature and tells you when it dims itself to stay cool.
assembly_guide: Connect the LEDs 16x module to the DataHub, and the DataHub to the PicoHub.
Run setup in the noknok app.

controls.action: On/off, brightness, light mode, colour and white amount
From the app (this lamp has no buttons)

config_schema.label: Light
config_schema.help: White uses the ring's own white LEDs: clean and efficient.

config_schema.label: Colour
config_schema.help: Used in Colour and Colour + white.

config_schema.label: White amount
config_schema.help: How much white is mixed in (Colour + white only).

config_schema.label: Temperature
config_schema.help: Chip temperature of the LED ring. It dims itself from 55 °C.
